title: 第13章 又要开始拯救新的角色了第14章 坏消息提前了一个月
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
;;
霍尔登城堡的练武场，地面铺着坚硬的青冈岩，此刻却布满了蛛网般的裂纹。
一把漆黑的巨斧呼啸而过，带起的劲风卷起了地上的落叶，随后重重地砸在特制的铁木桩上。
没有花哨的光效，只有沉闷的撞击声。
足以承受重骑兵冲锋的铁木桩，从中间整齐地断开，切口光滑如镜。
肖恩赤裸着上身，汗水顺着他精壮的肌肉线条滑落，在阳光下泛着油亮的光泽。
【嫪毐之躯】带来的不仅仅是某些方面令人发指的本钱，更有这具身体仿佛永远不知疲倦的恢复力。
自从那天解决了狮鹫骑士团后，他就像个不知疲倦的机器，把自己关在这个练武场里整整一个月。
因为他很清楚，上次能赢，纯粹是打了对方一个措手不及。
那个刀疤脸队长轻敌了，再加上【黑色切割者】这种传说级武器的属性压制，才让他有了装完逼还能全身而退的机会。
一旦侯爵反应过来，或者那群真正的老怪物们下场，凭他现在这点三脚猫的《蛮荒斧法》，估计连给人塞牙缝都不够。
“呼……”
肖恩随手将那把几百斤重的巨斧丢在一旁，地面随之一震。
他抓起挂在围栏上的毛巾，胡乱擦了擦脸上的汗。
远处，城堡二楼的阳台。
一道温婉的身影正静静地站在那里。
凯瑟琳穿着一件淡紫色的长裙，手里端着一杯温热的柠檬水，目光从未离开过楼下那个男人的身影。
风吹起她的裙摆，勾勒出岁月沉淀后的丰腴身姿。
看到肖恩停下动作，她便提起裙摆，快步向楼下走去。
这就是肖恩现在的日子。

她会细心地为他准备每一餐，衣物，和日常用品。
但那个该死的进度条，就像是死机了一样。
【角色：凯瑟琳】
【当前拯救进度：99％】
就差那1%。
这一个月里，肖恩试过各种办法。
送花？凯瑟琳感动得掉泪，进度条纹丝不动。
带她去领地巡视，享受平民的爱戴？
她满眼崇拜，进度条依旧装死。
顽强地卡在99%。
这让肖恩很是不爽。
就像是下载小电影到了99.9%，突然网断了。
“肖恩，累了吗？”
凯瑟琳的声音打断了他的思绪。
她走到近前，自然地递上水杯，另一只手掏出手帕，踮起脚尖，细致地替他擦拭额角的汗珠。
那股熟悉的香味钻进鼻孔。
肖恩低头看着她。

The ground of the training ground of Holden Castle is paved with hard green rock, but it is now covered with spiderweb-like cracks.
A huge black ax whizzed past, and the strong wind it brought up picked up the fallen leaves on the ground, and then hit the specially made iron and wooden stakes heavily.
There are no fancy light effects, just dull crashing sounds.
The iron wooden stakes, which are strong enough to withstand the charge of heavy cavalry, are neatly disconnected from the middle, and the cuts are as smooth as mirrors.
Sean's upper body was naked, sweat sliding down his strong muscle lines, glowing in the sun.
[Lao Ai's Body] brings not only outrageous capital in some aspects, but also this body's seemingly never-tiring resilience.
Since he defeated the Griffin Knights that day, he has been like a tireless machine, locking himself in this martial arts training ground for a whole month.
Because he knew very well that the last time he won, it was purely because he caught the opponent off guard.
The scar-faced captain underestimated the enemy. Coupled with the attribute suppression of legendary weapons like the [Black Cutter], he had the opportunity to escape unscathed after pretending to be cool.
Once the Marquis reacts, or the real old monsters end up, with his current "Wild Ax Technique" of the three-legged cat, he probably won't even be able to put a gap in someone's teeth.
"Huh..."
Sean casually threw the giant ax weighing several hundred kilograms aside, and the ground shook.
He grabbed the towel hanging on the fence and wiped the sweat from his face.
In the distance, the balcony on the second floor of the castle.
A gentle figure was standing there quietly.
Catherine was wearing a lavender dress, holding a glass of warm lemonade in her hand, her eyes never leaving the figure of the man downstairs.
The wind blew up her skirt, outlining her plump figure that had accumulated over time.
Seeing Sean stop, she lifted up her skirt and walked quickly downstairs.
This is Sean's day now.
She would carefully prepare every meal, clothing, and daily necessities for him.
But that damn progress bar seems to be frozen.
[Character: Catherine]
[Current rescue progress: 99%]
Just the 1% difference.
During this month, Sean tried various methods.
Send flowers? Catherine was moved to tears, and the progress stripe didn't move at all.
Take her to patrol the territory and enjoy the love of the common people?
Her eyes were full of admiration, and the progress bar still pretended to be dead.
Stubbornly stuck at 99%.
This made Sean very unhappy.
It's like downloading a short movie to 99.9%, and suddenly the network is disconnected.
"Sean, are you tired?"
Catherine's voice interrupted his thoughts.
She walked closer, handed over the water glass naturally, took out a handkerchief with her other hand, stood on tiptoes, and carefully wiped the sweat from his forehead.
The familiar fragrance penetrated the nostrils.
Sean looked down at her.
